dek: Attention TV/radio announcers: Please broadcast the following as soon as possible: The Hong Kong Observatory has issued the Very Hot Weather Warning. To prevent heat stroke, avoid prolonged activities outdoors. If engaged in outdoor work or activities, wear a wide-brimmed hat and light-coloured, loose-fitting clothes.
